'''VibroSword Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who led [[VibroSword Squadron]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. He served in [[Operation Roundabout]] and piloted an [[Eta-5 interceptor]], as did the rest of his squadron including [[Syal Antilles]]. He was present during a debacle in which Syal killed an overly aggressive [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] operative, and attempted to remove her rank, but was reprimanded for his sharpness by [[Shalla Nelprin]], who had intervened in the matter.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal" />
